function kernel!(out::Vector{Float32}, x::Vector{Float32}, n::Int32)
    for i=1:n
        prev_next_periodic = x[mod1(i-1,n)]
        prev_next_periodic_sq = prev_next_periodic^2
        out[i] = prev_next_periodic_sq
    end
    return nothing
end
